title: Grateful Dead Live at Thelma Theater on 1969-12-11
lineage: MAC >> Nakamichi DR-1 => Grace Design Lunatec V3 [Pre-Only] => Korg MR-1000 >> DSF [1-bit 5.6448 MHz Stereo] >> Korg MR-1000 => Korg AudioGate >> WAV [24/96] > (see notes)
source: 1 x Sony Microphone => Sony Portable Cassette Recorder [Monophonic] >> MAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent mono audience tape with warm, clear sound capturing a short early‑Dead set highlighted by a stellar Dark Star.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience (AUD) capture from 1969 using a single stage microphone; despite being mono it delivers unusually warm and detailed ambience that reviewers call the best‑sounding ’69 AUD they’ve heard. The performance itself, though brief, showcases classic early‑Dead material with Dark Star (and a French Suite Allemande jam) standing out as the highlight, making the set both sweet and memorable.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (mostly 5) and uniformly enthusiastic comments about both the music and the surprisingly excellent mono audience recording lead to a top‑tier rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Mono capture from a single stage microphone (DFC); warm, clear ambience; some reviewers note a synthetic stereo version exists elsewhere but this file is mono. No significant drop‑outs or distortion reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Short early‑Dead set with vintage vibe; smooth flow despite being incomplete, highlighted by strong improvisational moments.
